dashboard.title: About this page
dashboard.description: Shows an overview of the selected tenant's business performance: revenue, order count, average order value, customer count, conversion rate, and active loyalty accounts, plus revenue/order charts. Pick a tenant from the selector above to see its stats.

tenants_index.title: What is a Tenant?
tenants_index.description: A Tenant is an independent business on the platform — products, orders, and Agents are fully isolated between tenants. Use this page to view tenants and create new ones.
tenants_index.example: Name “Digi Store”, domain “digi-store” — the domain is lowercase letters/numbers/hyphens only and cannot be changed after creation.

tenants_create.title: Guide: creating a tenant
tenants_create.description: A new tenant represents a new business/store on the platform. Once created, you can define Agents, products, and orders for it.
tenants_create.name_hint: The business's display name, e.g. “Aria Digital Store”.
tenants_create.domain_hint: A unique, URL-safe identifier for the tenant (no spaces), e.g. aria-digital — this cannot be edited after creation.

tenants_edit.title: Guide: editing a tenant
tenants_edit.description: Only the name and status can be changed here — the domain is fixed after creation. “pending” means awaiting approval, “active” means live and usable, “suspended” means temporarily blocked for Agents.

agents_index.title: What is an Agent?
agents_index.description: An Agent is an AI/programmatic identity that talks to the platform on a tenant's behalf over MCP — searching products, placing orders, and so on. Every Agent belongs to exactly one tenant and can be active, inactive, or suspended.
agents_index.example: Use “Filter by tenant” above to see only one tenant's Agents.

agents_create.title: Guide: creating an Agent
agents_create.description: Before an AI system or bot can talk to a tenant over MCP, it needs an Agent defined for it.
agents_create.tenant_hint: The tenant this Agent belongs to.
agents_create.organization_hint: The numeric Organization ID inside that tenant, e.g. 1.
agents_create.name_hint: A recognizable name for the Agent, e.g. “Aria Store Sales Agent”.
agents_create.type_hint: What the Agent does: shopping (buy/sell), analytics (data analysis), customer_service (support), or custom.

agents_edit.title: Guide: editing an Agent
agents_edit.description: You can change the Agent's name and type here. Use the Suspend/Activate buttons on the Agents list to change its status.

products_index.title: Products
products_index.description: The selected tenant's active products, with SKU, price, and status. This page is read-only — products are created and edited through MCP or an Agent, not here.

products_show.title: Product details
products_show.description: Full details for one product: name, SKU (its unique inventory identifier), price, and description.

orders_index.title: Orders
orders_index.description: Orders placed for the selected tenant. Filter by status — pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, or refunded.

orders_show.title: Order details
orders_show.description: Order number, status, total, and line items. You can cancel the order below as long as it hasn't reached a final status (delivered, cancelled, or refunded) yet.

notifications_index.title: Notifications
notifications_index.description: Messages the system sent automatically for events like a new order, a shipment status change, or earned loyalty points. Use the filters to narrow results by type, status, or language.

settings.title: Tenant settings
settings.description: Right now the only editable setting is the tenant's default language, used for its own messages and notifications.

analytics.title: Analytics & KPIs
analytics.description: Calculate a KPI — e.g. revenue or conversion rate — over a time range. Results are cached for 1 hour, so repeating the same query is instant.
analytics.example: KPI type “Revenue”, period “monthly”, plus a start/end date — the result shows as a number, currency amount, or percentage depending on the KPI. Use the CSV/PDF buttons below to download the report.

performance.title: System performance
performance.description: Platform-wide operational metrics: average response time, cache hit rate, request count, memory usage, and open database connections. These numbers cover the whole platform, not a single tenant.
